O.content: The x-axis label "Price" is below a blue circular point, and the inscription "49%" appears directly above that point.
The x-axis label "Support" is below a blue circular point, and the inscription "33%" appears directly above that point.
The x-axis label "Design" is below a blue circular point, and the inscription "30%" appears directly above that point.
The inscriptions above the points aligned with Quality, Delivery, and Other are "14%", "29%", and "34%", respectively.

B.text: If each category label on the x-axis identifies its aligned plotted point and the percentage printed above that point is the category's current labeled rating share, then the category with the greatest such printed percentage is the required follow-up category; select the matching form option.
B.conditions: Applies to the displayed dashboard categories and the available Price, Support, and Design options; printed point labels are the designated evidence source.
